levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري

notes: «بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes over prev2's names up to «عبد الله بن حماد البصري»; the text writes «الأصم» itself, so the inherited run stops before him.
prev2's chain goes on through «محمد البصري» to an «أبي» its chunk cuts off; this text does not take those names, so they are not written.
prev1 names «هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ» but writes no chain (has_written_chain false) and is not used.
